name: AyurRaksha Detox Tea
shortDescription: Experience Ayurvedic wellness with AyurRaksha Detox Tea, a traditional blend of Triphala and Avuri that supports digestive health and natural bowel regularity.
description:
Traditional Ayurvedic Wellness, Naturally Inspired

Discover the essence of traditional Ayurvedic wellness with AyurRaksha Detox Tea, a thoughtfully developed herbal formulation inspired by India's rich botanical heritage.

Rooted in time-honoured Ayurvedic practices, this herbal blend brings together traditional plant-based ingredients in a convenient format for modern lifestyles. It reflects Ayurveda's holistic approach to wellbeing, where mindful daily habits and botanical traditions form an integral part of personal care.

AyurRaksha Detox Tea is designed for individuals who appreciate natural, plant-based wellness products and wish to incorporate traditional herbal preparations into their lifestyle. Its formulation draws on generations of Ayurvedic knowledge while offering the simplicity and convenience expected from a contemporary wellness product.

Whether exploring Ayurveda for the first time or continuing an established herbal wellness routine, AyurRaksha Detox Tea offers a connection to India's traditional botanical heritage.

Embrace the timeless tradition of Ayurveda with AyurRaksha Detox Tea — where herbal heritage meets modern wellness.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Traditional Ayurvedic formulation featuring four botanical ingredients.
  • Contains the three fruits of Triphala: Kadukkai, Thanrikkai and Nellikai.
  • Formulated to support digestive wellness and bowel regularity.
  • Features Avuri (Neeli), traditionally used in Indian herbal preparations.
  • Convenient pre-measured sachets for easy preparation.
  • Designed for use as part of an evening wellness routine.

Ingredients

  • Indigofera tinctoria – Avuri / Neeli
  • Terminalia chebula – Kadukkai / Haritaki
  • Terminalia bellirica – Thanrikkai / Bibhitaki
  • Phyllanthus emblica – Nellikai / Amla

How to Use / Directions

  • Take one sachet of AyurRaksha Detox Tea.
  • Add the contents to 100 ml of water.
  • Boil for 5 minutes.
  • Consume the prepared herbal drink as the last drink of the day.

Suitable For

Individuals seeking traditional Ayurvedic herbal support for digestive wellbeing and bowel regularity.

Warnings & Precautions

  • Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use, particularly if pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or managing an existing medical condition.
  • Use only as directed on the packaging.
  • Keep out of reach of children.

Net Quantity

40 sachets × 5 g = 200 g

name: Migro Prime Tablets
shortDescription: Discover Migro Prime Tablets, a traditional Ayurvedic herbal formulation from VPrime Health Care, crafted for a balanced approach to everyday wellness.
description:
Discover Migro Prime Tablets, a thoughtfully developed Ayurvedic herbal formulation inspired by India's rich heritage of traditional wellness practices. Created by VPrime Health Care, this formulation reflects Ayurveda's holistic philosophy of nurturing harmony between the mind, body and everyday lifestyle.

In today's fast-paced world, maintaining a balanced wellness routine is an important part of self-care. Migro Prime brings together traditional Ayurvedic knowledge and a contemporary approach to herbal wellness, offering a convenient option for individuals who appreciate plant-based formulations.

Developed with a focus on overall wellbeing, Migro Prime reflects the Ayurvedic belief that a balanced lifestyle, mindful habits and traditional botanical preparations can complement one another. The formulation is presented as part of a broader wellness philosophy that values consistency, balance and responsible self-care.

Formulated by Dr. Jegajothi Pandian, Migro Prime represents VPrime Health Care's commitment to making traditional Ayurvedic preparations accessible to modern consumers.

Whether exploring Ayurvedic wellness for the first time or continuing an established routine, Migro Prime offers an opportunity to connect with time-honoured herbal traditions.

Embrace the heritage of Ayurveda with Migro Prime Tablets, where traditional knowledge meets modern wellness.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Traditional Ayurvedic herbal formulation.
  • Features botanicals used in traditional Indian wellness practices.
  • Developed with a focus on mind-body balance and general wellbeing.
  • Formulated by Dr. Jegajothi Pandian
  • Convenient tablet format.
  • Part of VPrime Health Care's Ayurvedic wellness range.

Ingredients

  • Piper longum
  • Picrorhiza kurroa
  • Cucumis sativus
  • Clitoria ternatea
  • Crocus sativus

How to Use / Directions

  • Take one tablet two to three times daily after meals.

Suitable For

Adults interested in traditional Ayurvedic herbal preparations and general wellness

Warnings & Precautions

  • Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use, particularly if pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or managing a medical condition.
  • Follow the recommended dosage on the product label.
  • Do not exceed the recommended dosage.
  • Keep out of reach of children.
  • Not intended to replace prescribed medical treatment.

name: Etioment Pain Relief Roll-On, 50ml
shortDescription: Experience convenient Ayurvedic muscle and joint care with Etioment Pain Relief Roll-On, a herbal topical formulation featuring a non-greasy, easy-to-use applicator for targeted external application.
description:
Traditional Ayurvedic Care in a Convenient Roll-On

Discover Etioment Pain Relief Roll-On, an Ayurvedic herbal topical formulation that brings traditional botanical care into a convenient, modern format. Thoughtfully developed for muscle and joint care, Etioment combines the heritage of Ayurveda with the practicality of an easy-to-use roll-on applicator.

Designed for targeted external application, the roll-on format allows the product to be applied directly to specific areas without the inconvenience of handling creams or balms. Its non-greasy formulation and compact design make it a practical addition to everyday personal care.

Whether managing a busy workday, staying active or travelling, having a convenient topical care product within reach can make maintaining a wellness routine simpler. Etioment offers a portable option for individuals who appreciate traditional Ayurvedic approaches to body care.

The 50 ml packaging is designed for convenient storage and portability, while the roll-on applicator provides a straightforward and mess-free application experience.

Reflecting AyurRaksha's commitment to making traditional formulations accessible for contemporary lifestyles, Etioment brings together botanical heritage, functional packaging and everyday convenience.

Experience the simplicity of traditional Ayurvedic topical care with Etioment Pain Relief Roll-On.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Traditional Ayurvedic herbal topical formulation.
  • Designed for targeted muscle and joint care.
  • Non-greasy formulation for convenient application.
  • Roll-on applicator for direct, mess-free use.
  • Compact 50 ml packaging, convenient for home or travel.
  • Formulated by Dr. Jegajothi Pandian

Ingredients

  • Eucalyptus globulus – Eucalyptus
  • Sesame – Sesame Oil / Gingelly
  • Camphor – Karpooram
  • Haritaki – Terminalia chebula / Kadukkai
  • Sida cordifolia – Bala / Kurunthotti
  • Thymus vulgaris – Thyme

How to Use / Directions

  • Ensure the intended application area is clean and dry.
  • Shake the roll-on before use.
  • Roll the applicator gently over the desired area using light, even pressure.
  • Allow the product to dry before covering the area with clothing.

Suitable For

Individuals seeking an Ayurvedic topical product for localized muscle and joint care.

Warnings & Precautions

  • For external use only.
  • Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes.
  • Do not apply to broken or irritated skin unless specifically permitted by the label.
  • Discontinue use if skin irritation occurs.
  • Keep out of reach of children.

Net Quantity

50 ml – 1 Roll-On Bottle

name: AyurRaksha SuperHeal O3 Cream
shortDescription: Discover AyurRaksha SuperHeal O3 Cream, an ozonated topical formulation created for everyday skin care and conditioning, combining botanical-inspired wellness with modern skincare convenience.
description:
Thoughtful Care for Everyday Skin Comfort

Discover AyurRaksha SuperHeal O3 Cream, a thoughtfully developed topical skincare formulation that brings together contemporary ozonated skincare concepts and AyurRaksha's traditional approach to personal wellbeing.

Skin deserves consistent attention through changing seasons, environmental conditions and everyday activities. SuperHeal O3 Cream offers a convenient way to incorporate focused skin conditioning into a regular personal-care routine, especially for areas that may feel dry or require additional attention.

Designed for external application, this cream reflects a simple yet considered approach to skincare. Its topical format makes it suitable for inclusion in an established routine without the need for elaborate steps or complicated skincare rituals.

The distinctive O3 formulation sets SuperHeal apart within the AyurRaksha personal-care collection, combining a modern formulation concept with the brand's emphasis on traditional wellness-inspired products.

Whether refreshing your existing skincare collection or exploring a new approach to daily skin conditioning, SuperHeal O3 Cream offers a practical addition to a routine centered on mindful self-care.

With a focus on everyday convenience and thoughtful skincare, this formulation reflects AyurRaksha's commitment to making specialized personal-care products accessible to modern lifestyles.

AyurRaksha SuperHeal O3 Cream – where thoughtful formulation meets every day skincare.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Ozonated topical skincare formulation.
  • Designed for everyday skin conditioning and personal care.
  • Features olive-oil-based skincare ingredients.
  • Convenient cream format for localized external application.
  • Part of AyurRaksha's specialized skincare collection.
  • Formulated by Dr. Jegajothi Pandian

Ingredients

  • Extra Virgin Olive Oil – Used in skincare for its moisturizing and conditioning properties.
  • Ozone (O₃) – Used in the formulation's ozonation process.

How to Use / Directions

  • Clean the intended area gently with water and pat dry.
  • Apply a small amount of SuperHeal O3 Cream.
  • Massage lightly until absorbed.
  • Use 2–3 times daily or as directed by a physician.

Suitable For

Individuals seeking a topical product for skin conditioning and routine external skincare.

Warnings & Precautions

  • For external use only.
  • Avoid direct contact with eyes and mucous membranes.
  • Discontinue use if irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

name: AyurRaksha Dant Swasthya
shortDescription: Experience traditional Ayurvedic oral care with AyurRaksha Dant Swasthya, a herbal tooth powder designed to complement daily dental hygiene and leave your mouth feeling fresh.
description:
Traditional Ayurvedic Care for Everyday Oral Hygiene

Discover the goodness of traditional Ayurvedic oral care with AyurRaksha Dant Swasthya, a herbal tooth powder inspired by India's time-honoured approach to dental hygiene and personal wellbeing.

Rooted in the principles of Ayurveda, Dant Swasthya offers a botanical-inspired alternative to conventional toothpaste formats. Developed for everyday oral care, it brings traditional herbal practices into a convenient product designed to complement modern personal-care routines.

Maintaining good oral hygiene is an essential part of overall wellbeing. AyurRaksha Dant Swasthya reflects a holistic approach to personal care, encouraging regular attention to dental cleanliness and oral freshness as part of a balanced lifestyle.

Its traditional powdered format offers a distinctive oral-care experience for individuals who appreciate Ayurvedic products and wish to explore herbal alternatives within their daily routine.

Combining the heritage of Indian botanical traditions with the convenience of a ready-to-use preparation, Dant Swasthya fits naturally into a mindful personal-care routine.

Whether discovering traditional Ayurvedic oral care for the first time or continuing a familiar practice, AyurRaksha Dant Swasthya offers a simple way to embrace the botanical traditions associated with dental hygiene.

Rediscover traditional oral care with AyurRaksha Dant Swasthya – where Ayurvedic heritage meets everyday freshness.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Traditional Ayurvedic herbal tooth powder formulation.
  • Designed to complement daily oral hygiene.
  • Offers an alternative to conventional toothpaste formats.
  • Intended for routine dental cleaning and oral freshness.
  • Convenient powder format for personal oral-care routines.
  • Formulated by Dr. Jegajothi Pandian

Ingredients

  • Aghrakaram – Traditional herbal ingredient;
  • Chukku (Zingiber officinale) – Dry Ginger
  • Induppu – Rock Salt
  • Puthina Uppu – Mint Salt
  • Oma Uppu – Ajwain Salt
  • Thippili (Piper longum) – Long Pepper
  • Lavangam (Syzygium aromaticum) – Clove
  • Karuvelam Pattai – Acacia catechu / Black Catechu; Lavanga Pattai (Cinnamomum zeylanicum) – Cinnamon Bark

How to Use / Directions

  • Take a small quantity of Dant Swasthya tooth powder.
  • Apply to a wet, soft-bristled toothbrush.
  • Brush teeth gently.
  • Rinse the mouth thoroughly after brushing.

Suitable For

Individuals seeking a traditional herbal tooth powder as part of their regular oral hygiene routine.

Warnings & Precautions

  • For oral hygiene use only. Do not swallow.
  • Avoid contact with eyes.

shortDescription: Discover AyurRaksha Premium High Fiber Health Mix, a wholesome multigrain blend with pulses and dry fruits, crafted for convenient everyday nutrition and family wellness.
description:
Wholesome Nutrition for Everyday Family Wellness

Discover a thoughtful approach to everyday nutrition with AyurRaksha Premium High Fiber Health Mix, a wholesome nutritional blend developed to complement a balanced and active lifestyle.

Inspired by traditional Indian food practices, this health mix brings together the goodness of familiar, naturally derived food sources in a convenient powdered format. Designed with modern households in mind, it offers a practical addition to everyday nutritional routines.

Dietary fiber is an important part of a balanced diet, contributing to normal digestive function and overall nutritional wellbeing. AyurRaksha Premium High Fiber Health Mix is developed around this nutritional principle, offering a food-based option for those looking to make mindful choices about their daily nourishment.

Whether incorporated into a morning routine or enjoyed as part of a balanced eating plan, this versatile health mix offers convenience without compromising the brand's focus on wholesome food traditions.

Created for individuals and families who appreciate traditional nutrition with modern simplicity, it reflects AyurRaksha's commitment to making everyday wellness accessible through thoughtfully developed products.

Nourish your everyday routine with AyurRaksha Premium High Fiber Health Mix – a blend of wholesome nutrition, traditional inspiration and modern convenience.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Wholesome nutritional blend made with multigrains, pulses and dry fruits.
  • Developed with a focus on dietary fiber and everyday nutrition.
  • Contains naturally derived food ingredients.
  • No added sugar or preservatives
  • Convenient powdered format for easy preparation.

Ingredients

  • Multigrains
  • Ragi – Finger Millet
  • Jowar – Sorghum
  • Bajra – Pearl Millet
  • Barley
  • Rice
  • Pulses & Legumes
  • Fried Gram – Roasted Chana
  • Moong Dal – Green Gram
  • Chickpea – Desi Chana
  • Soya – Soybean
  • Nuts
  • Peanuts – Groundnuts
  • Badam – Almonds

How to Use / Directions

  • Take 3 tablespoons of AyurRaksha Health Mix
  • Add it to 1 cup of milk and stir thoroughly to avoid lumps
  • Heat on low flame for 3 minutes, stirring continuously
  • Add jaggery, honey, or natural sweetener as per your taste. Enjoy warm for a comforting and healthy drink!

Suitable For

Individuals seeking a convenient multigrain nutritional mix as part of a varied and balanced diet.

Warnings & Precautions

  • Contains barley (gluten), soy, peanuts and almonds.
  • Individuals with allergies to these ingredients should avoid consumption.

Net Quantity

100 g

name: AyurRaksha Gargling Oil
shortDescription: Experience traditional Ayurvedic oral care with AyurRaksha Gargling Oil, a botanical oil blend designed to complement daily oral hygiene through the time-honoured practice of oil pulling.
description:
Rediscover the Ayurvedic Tradition of Oral Wellness

Experience the timeless wisdom of Ayurveda with AyurRaksha Gargling Oil, a thoughtfully formulated herbal oil inspired by the traditional practice of oil pulling, known in Ayurveda as Gandusha or Kavala.

Rooted in centuries-old Indian wellness traditions, oil pulling has long been practised as part of personal oral care. AyurRaksha Gargling Oil brings this traditional ritual into a convenient format for individuals seeking a botanical approach to everyday oral hygiene.

A consistent oral-care routine is an important part of maintaining personal wellbeing. AyurRaksha Gargling Oil is designed to complement regular dental hygiene practices while offering an opportunity to experience a familiar Ayurvedic self-care tradition.

Developed with an appreciation for traditional herbal formulations, this product reflects AyurRaksha's commitment to making India's botanical wellness heritage accessible to contemporary lifestyles.

Whether beginning your journey with Ayurveda or looking to incorporate traditional practices into an established routine, AyurRaksha Gargling Oil offers a simple way to embrace mindful oral care.

Bring the heritage of Ayurveda into your everyday routine with AyurRaksha Gargling Oil – where traditional oral care meets modern convenience.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Traditional Ayurvedic oil-pulling formulation.
  • Contains five botanical ingredients.
  • Designed to complement everyday oral hygiene.
  • Inspired by the Ayurvedic practice of Gandusha and Kavala.
  • Convenient oil format for traditional oral-care routines.
  • Suitable for inclusion in a mindful personal-care regimen,

Ingredients

  • Sesamum indicum (Sesame Oil) – Traditionally used as a base oil in Ayurvedic preparations.
  • Cocos nucifera (Coconut Oil) – A commonly used plant-derived oil in traditional oral-care practices.
  • Ocimum sanctum (Tulsi / Holy Basil) – A botanical traditionally valued in Ayurveda.
  • Syzygium aromaticum (Clove) – Traditionally used in Indian oral-care formulations.
  • Azadirachta indica (Neem) – A botanical with a long history of traditional use in personal-care preparations.

How to Use / Directions

  • Measure 10 ml of AyurRaksha Gargling Oil in the morning on an empty stomach.
  • Swish gently around the mouth for 5–10 minutes.
  • Spit out the oil completely. Do not swallow.
  • Rinse the mouth with warm water if desired.

Suitable For

Adults interested in traditional Ayurvedic oil pulling as a complementary oral-hygiene practice.

Warnings & Precautions

  • For oral swishing only. Do not swallow.
  • Avoid use if allergic to sesame, coconut or any listed ingredient.

name: AyurRaksha Herbal Shampoo
shortDescription: Experience botanical hair care with AyurRaksha Herbal Shampoo, a nourishing herbal formulation designed to gently cleanse the scalp while leaving hair soft, smooth and naturally refreshed.
description:
Botanical Nourishment for Naturally Beautiful Hair

Rediscover the beauty of traditional herbal hair care with AyurRaksha Herbal Shampoo, a thoughtfully developed formulation that brings together the goodness of botanical extracts and the simplicity of everyday hair care.

Inspired by India's rich heritage of natural beauty rituals, this herbal shampoo is designed to gently cleanse the hair and scalp while supporting a fresh, comfortable and well-maintained appearance.

Everyday exposure to dust, pollution and styling products can leave hair feeling dull, dry and difficult to manage. AyurRaksha Herbal Shampoo offers a botanical-inspired approach to cleansing, helping remove everyday impurities while complementing your regular hair-conditioning routine.

With its focus on gentle cleansing and hair conditioning, the formulation is intended to leave hair feeling refreshed, softer and more manageable after washing. Its traditional herbal positioning makes it an appealing choice for individuals seeking to incorporate botanical hair-care products into their personal-care routine.

Developed with an appreciation for traditional Indian beauty practices, AyurRaksha Herbal Shampoo combines familiar herbal traditions with modern hair-care convenience.

Whether maintaining a simple everyday routine or exploring traditional botanical beauty products, AyurRaksha Herbal Shampoo offers a refreshing approach to caring for your hair.

Embrace naturally beautiful hair with AyurRaksha Herbal Shampoo – where botanical care meets everyday freshness.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Herbal shampoo featuring botanical extracts traditionally used in hair care.
  • Designed for gentle cleansing of the hair and scalp.
  • Helps remove everyday dirt, excess oil and product buildup.
  • Supports a soft, smooth and manageable hair feel.
  • Combines cleansing and conditioning-focused care in one formulation.
  • suitable for different hair types.

Ingredients

  • Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice (Aloe Vera) – A botanical ingredient commonly used for moisturizing and conditioning the hair and scalp.
  • Hibiscus Extract (Hibiscus species) – Traditionally used in herbal hair-care preparations;
  • Amalaki (Phyllanthus emblica / Amla) – Indian Gooseberry, traditionally used in botanical hair-care formulations.

How to Use / Directions

  • Take 15 ml of AyurRaksha Herbal Shampoo and dilute it with water.
  • Gently massage the diluted shampoo onto the scalp and hair, ensuring even coverage.
  • Leave on for 2–3 minutes.
  • Rinse thoroughly with clean water.
  • Use twice a week

Suitable For

Individuals looking for a botanical-inspired shampoo for routine hair and scalp cleansing.

Warnings & Precautions

  • For external use only.
  • Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water.
  • Discontinue use if irritation or an allergic reaction occurs.

name: AyurRaksha skin conditioning oil
shortDescription: Discover AyurRaksha Skin Conditioning Oil, a traditional Ayurvedic oil blend designed to nourish, moisturize and condition the skin, leaving it feeling soft and comfortable.
description:
Traditional Ayurvedic Nourishment for Everyday Skin Care

Experience the goodness of traditional Ayurvedic skincare with AyurRaksha Skin Conditioning Oil, a botanical formulation inspired by India's time-honoured herbal wellness practices.

Rooted in the traditional preparation known as Vetpalai Thailam, this oil brings Ayurvedic heritage into a convenient format for contemporary skincare routines. Developed with a focus on skin conditioning, it offers a botanical-inspired approach to maintaining soft, comfortable and well-cared-for skin.

Everyday exposure to changing weather, environmental conditions and frequent cleansing can leave skin feeling dry and lacking moisture. Incorporating an oil-based conditioning product into a consistent skincare routine can help maintain the skin's softness and supple appearance.

AyurRaksha Skin Conditioning Oil is designed for individuals who appreciate traditional herbal skincare and prefer incorporating botanical oils into their personal-care rituals.

Its oil-based format provides a familiar approach to skin nourishment, complementing everyday cleansing and moisturising practices while encouraging mindful self-care.

Whether exploring Ayurveda for the first time or continuing an established botanical skincare routine, AyurRaksha Skin Conditioning Oil offers a connection to India's traditional beauty and wellness heritage.

Embrace the beauty of traditional Ayurvedic care with AyurRaksha Skin Conditioning Oil – where botanical nourishment meets everyday skin wellness.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Traditional Ayurvedic oil formulation inspired by Vetpalai Thailam.
  • Features Wrightia tinctoria leaves and coconut oil.
  • Helps moisturize and condition dry-feeling skin.
  • Supports a softer, smoother and more supple skin feel.
  • Oil-based formulation for targeted skin conditioning.
  • Designed to complement everyday skincare routines.

Ingredients

  • Wrightia tinctoria Leaf – Vetpalai / Sweet Indrajao. Traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Siddha topical oil preparations.
  • Cocos nucifera Oil – Coconut Oil. A plant-derived oil commonly used in skincare for its moisturising and skin-conditioning properties.

How to Use / Directions

  • Cleanse the skin and pat dry after showering.
  • Apply AyurRaksha Skin Conditioning Oil to the desired areas.
  • Massage gently until the oil is evenly distributed and absorbed.
  • Use daily after showering

Suitable For

Individuals seeking traditional Ayurvedic topical oil care for skin conditioning, moisturization and maintaining a soft, supple skin feel.

Warnings & Precautions

  • For external use only.
  • Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes.

Net Quantity

100 ml

Botanical Hydration for Soft, Nourished Skin

Discover AyurRaksha Skin Well Food Moisturising Gel, a botanical-inspired skincare formulation developed to bring lightweight hydration and everyday comfort to your skin.

Daily exposure to heat, dry air, frequent washing and changing weather can leave skin feeling tight or lacking softness. A consistent moisturising routine helps maintain a comfortable skin feel and a smooth, cared-for appearance. Skin Well Food Moisturising Gel offers an easy addition to that routine, with a refreshing gel texture designed to spread comfortably and absorb without a heavy, greasy finish.

Inspired by traditional Indian botanical care, the formulation brings a heritage-led approach to contemporary skincare. Its emphasis on moisturising and conditioning makes it especially appealing to those who prefer a lighter texture over richer creams.

Used as part of regular personal care, the gel is intended to leave skin feeling hydrated, soft and supple. Its convenient format fits into a simple daily routine, whether at home or after a busy day.

Choose AyurRaksha Skin Well Food Moisturising Gel for a straightforward approach to botanical-inspired moisturising, everyday skin comfort and a naturally cared-for feel.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Provides moisturising care for dry and dehydrated skin.
  • Lightweight, non-greasy gel texture.
  • Designed to absorb without leaving a heavy residue.
  • Helps maintain a soft, smooth and supple skin feel.
  • Features botanical ingredients associated with traditional herbal skincare.
  • Suitable for inclusion in everyday skincare routines.

  • Vibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica) – Bibhitaki / Thanrikkai. A traditional Ayurvedic botanical associated with herbal wellness and personal-care preparations.

  • Rakta Chandana (Pterocarpus santalinus) – Red Sandalwood. A traditional botanical ingredient used in Indian herbal skincare preparations.

  • Cleanse the skin and gently pat dry.
  • Apply a suitable quantity of AyurRaksha Skin Well Food Moisturising Gel.
  • Spread gently over the intended skin area.

  • Use daily after bathing

description:
Botanical Wellness for Healthy-Looking Skin

Discover Skin Well Capsules, a thoughtfully developed botanical food supplement from AyurRaksha, inspired by India's traditional approach to herbal wellness and personal care.

Healthy-looking skin is an important part of overall wellbeing, and maintaining its natural appearance involves more than external skincare alone. Balanced nutrition, adequate hydration, restful sleep and consistent daily habits all contribute to a mindful approach to skin care.

Skin Well Capsules reflect this holistic philosophy by bringing traditional botanical knowledge into a convenient supplement format. Developed for individuals who appreciate plant-based wellness products, the formulation offers an opportunity to explore traditional herbal preparations alongside everyday personal-care practices.

Rooted in India's rich botanical heritage, Skin Well Capsules represent AyurRaksha's commitment to connecting established herbal traditions with contemporary wellness lifestyles.

Its convenient capsule format makes it a practical addition to a professionally guided wellness routine, without the need for elaborate preparation.

Whether maintaining an established skincare routine or exploring a broader approach to personal wellbeing, Skin Well Capsules offer a connection to traditional botanical practices.

Discover botanical-inspired wellness with Skin Well Capsules by AyurRaksha – where traditional herbal heritage meets modern self-care.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Botanical food supplement developed with a focus on skin wellness.
  • Features eight plant-derived ingredients.
  • Inspired by traditional Indian herbal preparations.
  • Designed to complement a balanced skincare and wellness routine.
  • Convenient capsule format for straightforward consumption.

Ingredients

  • Wrightia tinctoria Leaf Extract – Vetpalai, a botanical traditionally used in Indian herbal preparations.
  • Rubia cordifolia Root Extract – Manjistha / Indian Madder, traditionally valued in Ayurvedic wellness formulations.
  • Cucumis melo Fruit – Muskmelon, a botanical fruit ingredient.
  • Tinospora cordifolia Extract – Guduchi / Seenthil Kodi, a traditional Ayurvedic botanical.
  • Curcuma longa Rhizome Extract – Turmeric / Manjal, a commonly used botanical in Indian herbal preparations.
  • Ocimum tenuiflorum Extract – Tulsi / Holy Basil, traditionally valued in Ayurvedic formulations.
  • Phyllanthus emblica Extract – Amla / Nellikai / Indian Gooseberry, a traditional botanical ingredient.
  • Aloe vera Extract – Aloe Vera, a plant commonly used in personal-care and herbal formulations.

How to Use / Directions

  • Take 2 capsules daily.
  • Consume after dinner.
  • Take with water.

Suitable For

Adults interested in botanical food supplements as part of a balanced skin wellness and personal-care routine.

Warnings & Precautions

  • Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.
  • Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
  • Seek professional advice before use if taking medication or managing an existing medical condition.

Storage

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight

Net Quantity

60 Capsules per Bottle

name: Organics LaxaHealth Tea (TIN)
shortDescription: Discover LAXA HEALTH TEA by 18 Herbs Organics, a caffeine-free Senna herbal infusion traditionally used for short-term relief from occasional constipation and bowel regularity.
description:
Discover LAXA HEALTH TEA by 18 Herbs Organics, a traditional herbal infusion created for adults seeking occasional support for bowel regularity.

Inspired by longstanding herbal wellness traditions, this tea offers a familiar botanical format for those who appreciate straightforward, plant-based preparations. Its convenient tea bags make it easy to incorporate into an occasional digestive-care routine without complicated preparation.

Digestive wellbeing is influenced by many everyday habits. Drinking enough water, eating fibre-rich foods, staying active and maintaining regular meal times can all contribute to healthy bowel function. LAXA HEALTH TEA is intended for short-term use when occasional constipation requires additional attention, rather than as a daily long-term wellness drink.

Presented in a reusable tin containing 40 tea bags, the product brings traditional herbal preparation into a practical, easy-to-store format. It is designed for responsible use according to the product directions and appropriate health guidance.

Explore a traditional approach to occasional digestive care with LAXA HEALTH TEA by 18 Herbs Organics.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Made from pure cut Senna leaves.
  • Traditionally used for short-term relief from occasional constipation.
  • Supports bowel movements through Senna's natural stimulant laxative action.
  • Naturally caffeine-free herbal infusion.
  • Convenient, individually packed tea bags.
  • Available in a reusable tin containing 40 tea bags

Ingredients

  • Senna Leaves (Cassia angustifolia) – 100% pure cut leaves of organically grown Senna herb.
  • Senna leaves naturally contain compounds called sennosides, which belong to a group of plant compounds known as anthraquinone glycosides. These compounds are responsible for Senna's stimulant laxative activity.

How to Use / Directions

  • Place one LAXA HEALTH TEA bag into a cup of hot water.
  • Allow it to infuse for 3–5 minutes.
  • Remove the tea bag before drinking.
  • Do not add milk.
  • Honey or jaggery may be added for sweetness, if desired.

Suitable For

Adults seeking short-term herbal laxative support for occasional constipation.

Warnings & Precautions

  • Contains Senna, a stimulant laxative.
  • Do not use for more than seven days without medical advice.
  • Not suitable for children under 12 years without medical guidance.
  • Avoid use during pregnancy or breastfeeding

Storage

Store in a cool, dry place away from moisture and direct sunlight

Net Quantity

40 Tea Bags – 1 Tin

name: AyurRaksha Divine Healing Oil
shortDescription: Experience traditional Ayurvedic body care with DIVINE HEALING OIL by AyurRaksha, a herbal oil formulation designed for targeted skin conditioning and everyday muscle and joint care.
description:
Traditional Ayurvedic Care for Skin & Body Wellness

Discover DIVINE HEALING OIL by AyurRaksha, a traditional herbal oil formulation inspired by the rich heritage of Ayurvedic and Siddha medicine.

Developed with a focus on skin and body care, DIVINE HEALING OIL brings together time-honoured botanical knowledge and traditional oil preparation methods in a convenient topical format.

Daily activities, environmental exposure and changing weather conditions can influence how skin feels and responds to everyday care. Maintaining a consistent body-care routine is an important part of supporting skin comfort and personal wellbeing.

DIVINE HEALING OIL offers a traditional approach to topical care, making it a practical addition to personal wellness routines. Its oil-based formulation is designed for external application, combining the familiar experience of herbal oil massage with the convenience of a ready-to-use product.

Inspired by generations of traditional Indian herbal practices, the formulation reflects AyurRaksha's commitment to preserving botanical knowledge while making traditional preparations accessible to contemporary lifestyles.

Whether incorporating herbal oil massage into a regular body-care routine or exploring Ayurveda-inspired personal care, DIVINE HEALING OIL offers a connection to India's established traditions of botanical wellness.

DIVINE HEALING OIL – traditional Ayurvedic wisdom for everyday skin and body care.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Traditional Ayurvedic proprietary herbal oil formulation.
  • Prepared using a sesame oil base infused with traditional botanicals.
  • Developed for targeted skin and body care.
  • Suitable for gentle external massage according to directions.
  • Oil-based formulation designed to condition the skin.

Ingredients

  • Haridra Rhizome (Curcuma longa) – Turmeric / Manjal, traditionally used in Indian herbal preparations.
  • Nimba Leaf (Azadirachta indica) – Neem / Vembu, a botanical widely used in traditional Ayurvedic and Siddha formulations.
  • Haritaki Fruit (Terminalia chebula) – Kadukkai, a traditional botanical used in herbal preparations.
  • Vibhitaki Fruit (Terminalia bellirica) – Thanrikkai / Bibhitaki, a traditional Ayurvedic botanical.
  • Rakta Chandanam (Pterocarpus santalinus) – Red Sandalwood Heartwood, traditionally used in Indian herbal preparations.
  • Amalaki Fruit (Phyllanthus emblica / Emblica officinalis) – Amla / Nellikai, a familiar botanical in Ayurvedic formulations.
  • Vaasa Leaves (Adhatoda vasica) – Adathodai, traditionally used in Siddha and Ayurvedic preparations.
  • Sesame Oil (Sesamum indicum) – Tila Tailam / Nallennai, the plant-derived oil base of the formulation.

How to Use / Directions

  • Take a small quantity of DIVINE HEALING OIL.
  • Apply to the intended area.
  • Massage gently until the oil is absorbed.
  • Repeat as needed

Suitable For

Adults seeking a traditional Ayurvedic topical preparation for skin conditioning, external massage and body care

Warnings & Precautions

  • For external use only.
  • Do not swallow.
  • Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes.
  • Avoid applying to open wounds, burns, ulcers or infected skin without medical guidance.

Storage

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight

Net Quantity

100 ml

Traditional Siddha Wisdom for Liver Wellness

Discover BoozLiv Syrup, a thoughtfully developed Siddha herbal formulation from AyurRaksha, inspired by India's rich heritage of traditional botanical medicine and holistic wellbeing.

Created with a focus on liver wellness, BoozLiv brings together a selection of traditional botanical extracts in a convenient, ready-to-use liquid format. The formulation reflects the principles of Siddha medicine, where carefully selected herbs have long been incorporated into traditional wellness practices.

The liver plays an important role in the body's natural metabolic processes, making responsible lifestyle choices an essential part of maintaining overall wellbeing. Balanced nutrition, regular physical activity and limiting alcohol consumption are important considerations in a liver-conscious lifestyle.

BoozLiv Syrup represents AyurRaksha's approach to combining traditional Siddha knowledge with contemporary product convenience. Its individually packed sachets offer a practical format for people who appreciate traditional herbal preparations and prefer pre-measured servings.

Developed for adults exploring botanical wellness under appropriate professional guidance, BoozLiv connects traditional Indian medicinal heritage with modern wellness practices.

Experience the heritage of Siddha medicine with BoozLiv Syrup by AyurRaksha – where traditional botanical knowledge meets modern convenience.

  • Traditional Siddha proprietary herbal formulation.
  • Features six botanical ingredients associated with traditional liver-care preparations.
  • Developed with a focus on liver wellness.
  • Contains plant-derived extracts in a liquid syrup formulation.

Ingredients

  • Karicalai – Traditional herbal ingredient.
  • Keelaneli – Traditional Siddha botanical.
  • Milagu – Black Pepper.
  • Shombu – Traditional aromatic herbal ingredient.
  • Vilvaver – Bael Root.
  • Nilavembu – Traditional Siddha botanical.

  • Take one 10 ml sachet approximately 30 minutes after breakfast.
  • Take another 10 ml sachet after dinner.

name: Dhayani Herbal Hair Oil, 100ml
shortDescription: Nourish your hair naturally with Dhayani Herbal Hair Oil, a botanical blend featuring traditional herbal ingredients, designed for scalp care, softness and everyday hair conditioning.
description:
Traditional Botanical Nourishment for Beautiful Hair

Discover Dhayani Herbal Hair Oil, a botanical hair-care formulation inspired by traditional Indian beauty rituals and the longstanding use of herbal oils for hair and scalp care.

Healthy-looking hair begins with consistent care. Everyday exposure to sunlight, pollution, styling products and environmental changes can leave hair feeling dry, rough and difficult to manage. Dhayani Herbal Hair Oil offers a traditional approach to hair nourishment, making it a practical addition to a balanced hair-care routine.

Drawing on the heritage of botanical oil preparations, Dhayani combines familiar plant-based ingredients in a convenient, ready-to-use formulation. Its oil-based texture is designed for gentle scalp massage and hair conditioning, helping maintain a soft, smooth and well-cared-for appearance.

Whether included in a relaxing pre-wash massage or incorporated into a regular hair-care ritual, Dhayani provides a simple way to reconnect with traditional Indian hair-oiling practices.

Created for individuals who appreciate botanical beauty products, this herbal oil brings together traditional inspiration and everyday convenience.

Suitable for those exploring a more mindful approach to hair care, Dhayani Herbal Hair Oil offers a familiar way to care for the scalp and maintain naturally beautiful-looking hair.

Dhayani Herbal Hair Oil – traditional botanical care for soft, nourished and beautiful-looking hair.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Herbal hair oil featuring eight traditionally used botanical ingredients.
  • Designed to nourish and condition the hair and scalp.
  • Helps maintain a soft, smooth and manageable hair feel.
  • Suitable for gentle scalp massage and pre-wash hair care.
  • Features Sesame, Fenugreek, Red Onion and other traditional hair-care ingredients.

Ingredients

  • Aloe Vera (Aloe barbadensis) – Traditionally used in hair and scalp conditioning formulations.
  • Sesame Seeds (Sesamum indicum) – A familiar botanical ingredient associated with traditional hair-oil preparations.
  • Fenugreek (Trigonella foenum-graecum) – Vendhayam, traditionally used in Indian herbal hair-care practices.
  • Red Onion (Allium cepa) – A botanical ingredient used in traditional hair-care preparations.
  • Curry Leaves (Murraya koenigii) – Karuveppilai, traditionally valued in Indian hair-oiling practices.
  • Coconut Oil (Cocos nucifera) – A plant-derived oil commonly used for hair conditioning.
  • Amla (Phyllanthus emblica) – Indian Gooseberry / Nellikai, traditionally used in Ayurvedic hair-care formulations.
  • Badam (Prunus dulcis) – Almond, a plant-derived ingredient traditionally used in nourishing hair preparations.

How to Use / Directions

  • Before Bath:
  • Take a suitable quantity of Dhayani Herbal Hair Oil.
  • Apply evenly to the scalp and hair.
  • Massage gently using your fingertips.
  • Leave on for approximately 45 minutes.
  • Wash the hair using your regular shampoo.
  • For Regular Hair Care:
  • A smaller quantity may be applied during the day.
  • Alternatively, a small quantity may be applied at night.

Suitable For

Individuals seeking a traditional botanical hair oil for regular scalp massage, hair conditioning and maintaining soft, manageable hair.

Warnings & Precautions

  • For external use only.
  • Avoid direct contact with eyes.
  • Keep out of reach of children.

Net Quantity

100 ml

name: Organics Herbo Protein Powder
shortDescription: Discover HERBO PROTEIN Powder by 18 Herbs Organics, a traditional plant-based formulation made from Mucuna pruriens, inspired by India's rich heritage of botanical nutrition.
description:
Traditional Botanical Nutrition Inspired by Siddha Heritage

Discover HERBO PROTEIN Powder by 18 Herbs Organics, a distinctive plant-based formulation inspired by India's longstanding traditions of botanical nutrition and Siddha wellness.

Rooted in traditional Indian herbal knowledge, HERBO PROTEIN brings together the familiarity of a naturally derived botanical ingredient with the convenience of a modern powdered preparation.

Unlike conventional protein blends made from multiple ingredients, HERBO PROTEIN is formulated around a single traditional botanical source. Its uncomplicated composition reflects the brand's focus on herbal preparations and naturally derived plant ingredients.

Developed for individuals interested in exploring traditional botanical nutrition, this product represents a connection between India's heritage of medicinal plants and contemporary approaches to wellness.

The convenient powdered format offers a practical way to incorporate a traditional preparation into an individually guided nutritional routine. Its formulation reflects the philosophy of Siddha wellness, which values botanical knowledge and considered approaches to personal wellbeing.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Single-ingredient botanical powder made from Mucuna pruriens.
  • Plant-derived formulation inspired by traditional Siddha practices.
  • Contains naturally occurring plant proteins.
  • contains 23–35% protein
  • Siddha functional food

Ingredients

  • Mucuna pruriens – 100%
  • Common names:
  • Velvet Bean
  • Kapikachhu / Kapikachu
  • Poonaikali (Tamil)
  • Mucuna pruriens is a traditional botanical used in Indian herbal preparations. Its seeds naturally contain plant proteins and L-DOPA (levodopa), a pharmacologically active compound.

How to Use / Directions

  • 1 gram per dose, described as one teaspoonful.
  • Twice daily, preferably with milk or food.

Suitable For

Adults interested in traditional botanical preparations containing Mucuna pruriens, subject to appropriate professional guidance.

Warnings & Precautions

  • Avoid use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
  • Individuals with liver or kidney disorders should avoid use unless specifically advised by their treating clinician.
  • Consult a healthcare professional before use if taking prescription medication, particularly medicines for Parkinson's disease or psychiatric conditions.

Storage

Store in a cool, dry place away from moisture.

Net Quantity

100 g – 1 Jar

Discover HIBISCUS TEA by 18 Herbs Organics, a vibrant herbal infusion that celebrates the beauty and natural character of hibiscus flowers.

Presented in a convenient tin containing 40 tea bags, HIBISCUS TEA combines traditional botanical inspiration with the simplicity of modern tea preparation.

name: AyurRaksha Piles Well Pack
shortDescription: Piles, also known as hemorrhoids, are swollen blood vessels in the rectum and anus, causing discomfort, pain, and sometimes bleeding. There are two main types: internal hemorrhoids, which may bleed and protrude from the anus, and external hemorrhoids, which form under the skin around the anus, leading to itching and irritation. These conditions often result from straining during bowel movements, increased pressure in the anal area, and lifestyle factors such as a diet low in fiber and high in junk food. They are commonly observed in elderly individuals, pregnant women, and those who spend prolonged periods sitting.

Ayur Raksha Foot Bath Powder (300g)

A restorative Ayurvedic therapeutic foot soak powder enriched with cooling herbs and botanical minerals. Traditionally formulated to relieve pedal tiredness, soften dry skin and cracked heels, improve circulation to lower extremities, and soothe burning sensations.

  • Soothes Tired, Aching Feet & Ankles
  • Helps Soften Cracked Heels & Dry Soles
  • Supports Natural Peripheral Circulation
  • Provides Cooling Relief from Burning Sensation

Usage Instructions:

Add 2–3 tablespoons of Ayur Raksha Foot Bath Powder into a basin of lukewarm water. Soak feet for 15–20 minutes. Gently pat dry and follow with Ayur Raksha Skin Conditioning Oil or SuperHeal O3 Cream.
